Preserved77 and79 both write one checkpoint for two units and get two hits in a fresh-process replay. Repeated-analysis correctness and export preservation assertions remain.

diagnostic_profile_scope: Only analyzer children created for diagnostic profiling were sampled. Profile75 and warm79/79b were intentionally stopped; warm79 used relative paths and missed the cache. Warm79c finished with 34 cache hits and zero function analyses under sampling. Profiles identified summary copies, diagnostic rendering and compact report interning. Cold81 contains six five-second samples from an uncached child, intentionally stopped after profiling; they identify diagnostic identity construction and eager object-view resolution. These are not acceptance timing runs.
